title: Popup spacing — the gaps between groups and boxes

steps.headline: Sound: 16px between groups, like your spacing rule?

steps.headline: Boxes next to each other in one group: 6px or 8px apart?
steps.notice: Today the app mixes both. 8px: the Settings list, Cloud providers, Local models, Permissions. 6px: Remote Access, Preferences, Keyboard Shortcuts (Sound's list is 3–4px). Your earlier rule said 6px; the Settings list you just aligned uses 8px. Whichever you pick becomes the one gap everywhere.
steps.risk: The difference is 2px per gap — small on one screen, but it is what makes screens feel the same side by side.

variants.label: 6px apart
variants.summary: Your earlier rule. The Settings list, Cloud providers, Local models and Permissions tighten slightly.

variants.label: 8px apart
variants.summary: Matches the Settings list. Remote Access, Preferences, Shortcuts and Sound's list loosen slightly. My pick: the Settings list is the screen people see most.
